description: Platform brain: pull and brief at session start, offer to save learnings after long sessions. Runs in bash (Git Bash on Windows) and uses the first working python3 / python / py.

hooks.command: for p in python3 python py; do if "$p" -c '' </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; then "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/session_start.py"; exit 0; fi; done; exit 0
for p in python3 python py; do if "$p" -c '' </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; then "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/stop_nudge.py"; exit 0; fi; done; exit 0
